name: Pro Approval Workflow Builder
description: Multi-level approval rule builder: auto-laid-out React Flow canvas of approver, condition, parallel and outcome steps, react-querybuilder rules, role / person / manager-chain approvers, zod-validated JSON import/export, issue checker, undo/redo and a simulation panel showing who approves a sample request.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires after every edit, undo, redo or import

props.name: fields
props.description: react-querybuilder fields rules can test; `sample` seeds the simulator

props.name: directory
props.description: People with roles and managerId, used to resolve approvers

props.name: roles
props.description: Roles offered in the approver picker (default: all directory roles)

props.name: defaultSample
props.description: Initial sample request for the simulation tab

props.name: onPublish
props.description: Publishes a version-bumped workflow; hidden when omitted
